threads.body: [General] Moving `server.port` out of the default inventory incorrectly implies that Elasticsearch transport requires experimental attributes to emit it; the shared database extractor emits it for a single endpoint on a non-default port regardless of that setting. Make default metadata collection exercise that case and regenerate the catalog so the attribute remains documented in both profiles. The same issue affects `elasticsearch-transport-5.3` at lines 9438–9439.
threads.hunk:
@@ -9328,6 +9346,8 @@ libraries:
         type: LONG
       - name: server.address
         type: STRING
+      - name: server.port
+        type: LONG
